what: Planned no-spawn regression is not observable
scenario_or_breakage: A python3 stub that only exits non-zero still passes if SessionStart wrongly invokes python3 and then swallows the failure, so the required pre-check can regress without the test failing
suggested_fix: Make the stub write a marker or counter and assert it is absent, or add a structural check that the claude-implement-* pre-check occurs before the python3 CLI call
